calls.title: Demo Call with Chris Tummarello from RE/MAX Holdings,
calls.summary: ReMax's meeting focused on the necessity for a more robust feature flagging and A/B testing solution as their software engineering team expanded from 3 to nearly 30 members, highlighting the limitations of their current GitLab-integrated Unleash setup. Chris Tummarello pointed out issues like caching errors and demands for advanced A/B testing capabilities. The team prefers self-hosted solutions for control over uptime and caching, with Growth Book being introduced as a viable cost-effective option. Performance is crucial, necessitating features like sub-millisecond flag evaluations and multi-environment support. The estimated self-hosted enterprise pricing stands at around $95,000 per year for 55 seats, and next steps involve further vendor evaluations and technical demos.
calls.keywords: feature flagging, self-hosted, A/B testing, caching proxy, enterprise pricing, experimentation
